value.rationale: The result identifies the complete sharp knot-placement phase diagram for the smallest genuine continuous linear spline. Its balanced 17/9 minimum, unattained 7/3 skew-mesh supremum and exact positivity defect are directly interpretable finite-element error-amplification quantities. The sharp 2/3 gap from affine projection as one knot reaches a boundary reveals a substantive L∞ instability despite strong L2 convergence, which is not delivered by generic spline boundedness.
